blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Science, technology, and innovation policies are crucial for competitiveness, yet their diversity and scale make them difficult to map and monitor consistently. Existing approaches rely heavily on manual survey efforts, which are costly and challenging to scale across countries. Large language models (LLMs) enable new possibilities for extracting and structuring information from long and unstructured policy documents.
This paper presents an application of LLMs as “AI respondents” for generating structured survey responses from policy texts. We develop a data extraction pipeline based on long-context in-context learning to map information from public web sources into predefined survey categories, including policy instruments, target groups, and thematic areas. The pipeline integrates a validation step using a secondary LLM to assess relevance and evidence, alongside comparisons with human-provided responses.
Using a multi-country dataset, we evaluate the alignment between LLM-generated and human-generated outputs through overlap measures and cross-validation. Results show that LLMs achieve high agreement for structured indicators (84–95%), while differences remain in free-text fields, where models tend to provide more detailed procedural descriptions.
These findings highlight the potential of hybrid human–AI workflows for policy monitoring, improving both efficiency and scalability while maintaining the need for human validation and contextual interpretation.
blocks.zh:
科学、技术和创新政策对竞争力至关重要,但其多样性和规模使其难以持续地绘制和监测。 现有办法在很大程度上依靠人工调查,而人工调查费用高昂,而且难以在各国推广。 大型语言模型(LLMS)为从冗长和无结构的政策文件中提取和编排信息提供了新的可能性。
本文件介绍了作为“大赦国际答复者”的法学硕士课程应用情况,以便从政策案文中生成结构化的调查答复。 我们开发了一个数据提取管道,其基础是长文内文学习,将公共网络来源的信息映射成预先界定的调查类别,包括政策工具、目标群体和专题领域。 管道综合了一个验证步骤,利用次级LLM评估相关性和证据,同时与人提供的反应进行比较。
我们利用多国数据集,通过重叠计量和交叉验证,评价LLM产生的产出与人类产生的产出之间的一致。 结果显示,有限责任公司对结构化指标(84-95%)达成了高度一致,而自由文本领域的差异依然存在,模型往往提供更详细的程序说明。
这些调查结果突出表明了人类-AI混合工作流程在政策监测方面的潜力,提高了效率和可扩展性,同时保持了对人类验证和背景解释的需要。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) policies are complex socio-technical constructs that play a central role in shaping national competitiveness and addressing global challenges. Yet, systematic mapping and continuous monitoring of these policies remain costly and labor-intensive, particularly in the context of large-scale international surveys such as the EC-OECD STIP Compass [ 8 ] . The Compass aggregates data on STI policy initiatives across OECD and partner countries, relying on expert respondents to fill in structured survey instruments linked to web-based sources of evidence. While this approach provides a unique comparative perspective, it faces challenges of scale, consistency, and timeliness as the number and complexity of initiatives expand.
blocks.zh: 科学、技术和创新(科技创新)政策是复杂的社会技术结构,在形成国家竞争力和应对全球挑战方面发挥着核心作用。 然而,对这些政策进行系统的摸底和持续监测仍然是代价高昂和劳力密集型的,特别是在诸如欧共体-经合组织科技和创新政策指南等大规模国际调查的背景下。 《指南》汇总了经合组织和伙伴国家科技和创新政策举措的数据,依靠专家答复者填写与网络证据来源相关的结构化调查工具。 虽然这一方法提供了独特的比较视角,但随着倡议数量和复杂性的增加,它面临着规模、一致性和及时性方面的挑战。

blocks.en: LLMs are redefining natural language processing (NLP) by enabling machines to internalize knowledge from large unstructured corpora and to adapt to diverse downstream tasks through prompting rather than parameter updates [ 24 , 17 , 4 ] . Recent generative LLMs such as GPT-4o are capable of long-context reasoning and in-context learning, making them suitable for information extraction from extended policy documents and web content. Their ability to generate structured responses aligned with human-designed schemas offers a potential solution to the persistent difficulties of innovation policy data collection and validation.
blocks.zh: LLMs正在重新定义自然语言处理(NLP),使机器能够从大型非结构化的corpora中将知识内化,并通过提示而不是参数更新来适应不同的下游任务[24,17,4]. 最近的GPT-4o等遗传性LLMs能够进行长文推理和内文学习,使其适合从扩展政策文件和网络内容中提取信息. 它们能够根据人为设计的计划作出有条理的反应,为创新政策数据收集和验证方面的长期困难提供了潜在的解决办法。

blocks.en: However, integrating LLMs into international policy monitoring is not straightforward. Prior work shows that LLMs can act as “artificial respondents”, replicating social science experiments by generating survey answers conditioned on demographic profiles [ 2 ] . On the other hand, LLM-driven data generation may introduce systematic biases and distortions—so-called model collapse—if models are repeatedly trained on synthetic outputs [ 23 ] . Moreover, innovation policy data pose unique challenges as policies are heterogeneous, multi-scalar, and embedded in institutional contexts that are not always captured in publicly available sources [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,将有限责任管理纳入国际政策监测并不简单。 以往的研究表明,法学硕士可以充当“人工答辩人”,通过生成以人口概况为条件的调查答案复制社会科学实验。 另一方面,LLM驱动的数据生成可能会引入系统性的偏差和扭曲——即所谓的模型崩溃——如果模型反复接受合成输出的培训[23]. 此外,创新政策数据构成独特的挑战,因为政策多种多样,具有多种规模,并嵌入体制背景,而这种环境并不总是被公开来源所掌握[7]。

blocks.en: In the STIP Compass workflow, expert respondents from member nations cite web-based responses for each policy initiative and fill a structured survey by selecting taxonomy codes [ 5 ] for policy instruments (PI), target groups (TG), and policy themes (TH) along with free-text fields. A short example of this workflow is shown in Table 1 . We cast this as an LLM-assisted survey-filling task: given the web-scraped initiative text, the model predicts the corresponding sets of PI/TG/TH codes and generates the free-text fields: description and objectives.
blocks.zh: 在科学、技术和革新政策指南工作流程中,来自成员国的专家答复者为每项政策举措提供了网上答复,并通过选择政策工具的分类代码[5]、目标群体、政策主题(TH)以及自由文本字段来填补结构性调查。 这一工作流程的一个简短例子见表1。 我们将此作为LLM协助的填充调查任务:鉴于网络拼贴倡议文本,模型预测对应的PI/TG/TH代码集并生成自由文本域:描述和目标.

blocks.en:
This paper contributes to the emerging field of AI-assisted policy intelligence by presenting an operational pipeline that integrates LLM capabilities for the EC-OECD STIP Compass.
Specifically, we design and test a data extraction pipeline that uses long-context prompting to map survey taxonomy codes (policy instruments, themes, and target groups) from web-scraped content provided by survey respondents. A secondary validation layer employs an LLM to evaluate outputs on dimensions of relevance and evidence. Using a pilot across six OECD countries (Canada, Finland, Germany, Korea, Spain, and Türkiye), we assess the overlap between LLM-generated and human-generated survey responses and explore complementarities in descriptive and objective fields [ 11 ] . Our findings show that LLMs achieve high overlap in structured codes (84–95%) but diverge in textual fields, where AI tends to provide more detailed procedural descriptions while humans emphasize contextual and societal impacts. These insights highlight the promise of hybrid human-AI approaches for international policy monitoring. The key contributions of this paper are as follows: • We design an integrated data extraction pipeline that leverages long-context in-context learning to process lengthy unstructured policy documents. • We implement a validation layer that evaluates relevance and evidence by employing another LLM as a validator model. • We evaluate the pipeline in a pilot study covering six OECD countries, analyzing overlap, agreement, and cross-validation between LLM-generated and human-generated responses.
blocks.zh:
本文通过为欧共体-经合组织科学、技术和革新政策指南提供整合LLM能力的运行管道,为新兴的AI辅助政策情报领域做出了贡献。
具体地说,我们设计和测试一个数据提取管道,利用长文提示,从调查答卷人提供的网络搜索内容中绘制调查分类编码(政策工具、主题和目标群体)。 二级验证层使用LLM来评价相关性和证据方面的产出。 我们利用在六个经合组织国家(加拿大、芬兰、德国、韩国、西班牙和蒂尔基耶)进行的一项试点,评估LLM生成的调查答复与人为生成的调查答复之间的重叠,并探讨描述性和客观领域的互补性[11]。 我们的研究结果表明,法学硕士在结构化代码(84-95%)中实现了高度重叠,但在文字领域却存在差异,AI倾向于提供更详细的程序描述,而人类则强调背景和社会影响。 这些见解突出表明了国际政策监测采用人类-AI混合方法的前景。 本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们设计了一个综合数据提取管道,利用长文内文字学习处理冗长的无结构政策文件。 我们利用另一个LLM作为验证模型,执行一个评估相关性和证据的验证层。 我们在一项涵盖六个经合组织国家的试点研究中评估了该管道,分析了LLM产生的和人为产生的反应之间的重叠、协议和交叉验证。

blocks.en: We design an integrated data extraction pipeline that leverages long-context in-context learning to process lengthy unstructured policy documents.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个综合数据提取管道,利用内容中的长文学习处理冗长的无结构的政策文件。

blocks.en: We implement a validation layer that evaluates relevance and evidence by employing another LLM as a validator model.
blocks.zh: 我们使用另一个LLM作为验证模型,实施一个验证层,来评价相关性和证据.

blocks.en: We evaluate the pipeline in a pilot study covering six OECD countries, analyzing overlap, agreement, and cross-validation between LLM-generated and human-generated responses.
blocks.zh: 我们在一项涵盖六个经合组织国家的试点研究中评估了该管道,分析了LLM产生的和人为产生的反应之间的重叠、协议和交叉验证。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The methodological challenges of collecting and comparing STI policy data have long been recognized in the literature on policy mixes and innovation systems. Policies are difficult units of analysis, and large-scale cross-country data are costly to compile and validate [ 8 ] . Efforts to address these challenges have included international surveys and expert-driven databases such as the OECD STIP Compass, yet these approaches are constrained by reporting burden, data gaps, and inconsistencies across national contexts.
blocks.zh: 收集和比较科学、技术和创新政策数据的方法挑战早已在关于政策组合和创新系统的文献中得到确认。 政策是难以分析的单位,大规模跨国数据的汇编和验证费用高昂[8]. 应对这些挑战的努力包括国际调查和专家驱动的数据库,如经合组织科技和创新政策指南,但这些方法受到报告负担、数据差距和各国国情不一致的制约。

blocks.en: The rise of LLMs introduces new opportunities to address these challenges. LLMs have been applied successfully in tasks such as information extraction, summarization, and question answering, often outperforming earlier supervised NLP methods [ 24 , 17 ] . Their in-context learning capabilities allow them to adapt dynamically to survey-style questions without the need for costly labeled training data [ 4 ] . Recent studies demonstrate the ability of LLMs to act as proxies for human subjects in social science experiments, suggesting their potential as scalable substitutes or complements to traditional survey respondents [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 有限责任方案的增长为应对这些挑战带来了新的机会。 在诸如信息提取、汇总和问答等任务中成功应用了法学硕士学位,往往优于早先监督的NLP方法[24、17]。 它们的内涵学习能力使其能够动态地适应调查式的问题,而不需要昂贵的贴有标签的培训数据[4]. 近期的研究表明,LLMs在社会科学实验中能够作为人类主体的代理,表明其作为可伸缩替代或补充传统调查受访者的潜力[2].

blocks.en: At the same time, concerns remain about their reliability. Shumailov et al. [ 23 ] warn of distributional drift and degradation in model outputs when systems recursively train on synthetic data. In the context of STI policy, the absence of gold-standard labeled datasets and the heterogeneous nature of policy initiatives make fine-tuning approaches less feasible, as highlighted in recent experimentation with the STIP Compass [ 11 ] . Instead, long-context prompting combined with expert-designed taxonomies offers a pragmatic way to leverage LLMs while maintaining human oversight.
blocks.zh: 同时,对其可靠性仍然感到关切。 舒迈洛夫等人. [23] 当系统对合成数据进行循环训练时,警告模型输出物的分布漂移和退化。 在科学、技术和创新政策方面,由于缺少金本位数据集,以及政策举措的多样化性质,微调办法不太可行,正如最近对科学、技术和革新政策指南的试验所强调的那样[11]。 相反,长篇小说与专家设计的分类法相结合,为在维持人类监督的同时利用有限责任公司提供了一个务实的方法。

blocks.en: Our work builds on these strands by testing an operational pipeline that integrates LLMs into the STIP Compass survey process. While prior research has explored web-based policy document analysis and retrieval-augmented methods, our contribution is to compare human-provided and AI-generated responses across multiple dimensions of STI policy data. In doing so, we extend calls to leverage the “new data frontier” in innovation studies [ 7 ] through AI-driven approaches for international policy monitoring.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作以这些方面为基础,测试了将有限责任公司纳入科学、技术和革新政策指南调查进程的运行管道。 虽然以前的研究探讨了基于网络的政策文件分析和检索强化方法,但我们的贡献是在科学、技术和创新政策数据的多个层面比较由人类提供的答复和由人工生成的答复。 为此,我们呼吁通过大赦国际推动的国际政策监测办法,利用创新研究中的“新数据前沿”。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the data extraction pipeline for the EC-OECD STIP Compass survey. The raw data were obtained from the OECD and consist of the content from URLs that survey participants identified as relevant policy initiatives. The following subsections describe the preparation of the data for pre-filling, prompt design, and evaluation. Figure 1 illustrates the workflow of our methodology.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们叙述为欧共体-经合组织科学、技术和创新政策指南调查提供的数据提取管道。 原始数据来自经合组织,包括调查参与者确定为相关政策举措的URL内容。 以下各小节介绍为预填,即时设计和评价准备数据的情况. 图1说明了我们方法的工作流程。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Methodological workflow of the study: starting from OECD-scraped policy texts, followed by chunked summarization and data preparation, prompt design with survey questions, and information extraction using GPT-4o-128k [ 20 ] . Validation and evaluation involve comparing LLM-generated outputs with human annotations, as well as cross-validation using model fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 图1:研究的方法工作流程:从经合组织拼凑的政策案文开始,然后是块块的汇总和数据编制、带有调查问题的快速设计以及使用GPT-4o-128k [20] 提取信息。 验证和评价涉及将LLM产生的产出与人类说明进行比较,以及使用模型微调进行交叉验证。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据编制

blocks.en: We processed the survey data and the scraped text provided by the OECD to retain only those initiatives with sufficient content for analysis. Initiatives containing fewer than 200 tokens (fewer than 100 words) were discarded as insufficient for analysis. In contrast, initiatives with more than 120,000 tokens were further processed to fit within the LLM context window. For this purpose, we devised a chunked summarization method that divided the initiative content into chunks of 50,000 tokens and prompted an LLM to summarize each chunk while retaining underlying information related to STI policies. The resulting summaries were then aggregated by the LLM to produce a complete text containing all relevant initiative information. The prompts designed for the chunked summarization method are given below.
blocks.zh: 我们处理了调查数据和经合组织提供的废稿,只保留那些内容足以进行分析的倡议。 含有不到200个符号(100字以下)的倡议因不足以进行分析而被放弃。 与此形成对照的是,有超过12万个代币的倡议被进一步处理,以适应LLM背景窗口. 为此,我们设计了一种组合式汇总方法,将倡议内容分成5万个符号的块,并促使一个LLM汇总每个块,同时保留与科技和创新政策有关的基本信息。 随后,LLM汇总了由此产生的摘要,以产生包含所有相关举措信息的完整文本。 以下列出为整块整数法设计的提示。

blocks.en: Individual Chunk Prompt: “The following is a set of texts related to a policy initiative: “+ chunk +” Based on this list of docs, write a detailed account covering description, objectives, dates, policy themes and instruments, key stakeholders, budgets, and evaluations. Capture exact details, examples, and cases for these dimensions. Be thorough, detailed, and comprehensive. Use only text from the provided documents.”
blocks.zh: 个人Chunk Express:“以下是与政策举措有关的一套案文:“+块+” 根据这份文件清单,详细叙述说明、目标、日期、政策主题和文书、主要利益攸关方、预算和评价。 获取这些维度的确切细节、例子和案例。 要彻底,详细,全面. 只使用所提供的文档中的文本 。 “

blocks.en: Chunk Summary Aggregation Prompt: “The following is a set of detailed summaries: “+ chunked_summaries +” Take these and generate a detailed account covering description, objectives, dates, policy themes and instruments, key stakeholders, budgets, and evaluations. Capture exact details, examples, and cases for these dimensions. Be thorough, detailed, and comprehensive. Use only text from the provided summaries.”
blocks.zh: “以下是一组详细摘要:“+ 块_摘要+” 采用这些方法并详细叙述说明、目标、日期、政策主题和文书、主要利益攸关方、预算和评价。 获取这些维度的确切细节、例子和案例。 要彻底,详细,全面. 只使用所提供的摘要的文本 。 “

blocks.en: 3.2 Pre-filling - Long-Context In-Context Learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 预填 - 长文内文学习

blocks.en:
Long-context in-context learning refers to the ability of LLMs with extended context windows to generalize examples embedded in lengthy prompts, often spanning thousands of tokens [ 3 ] . Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), in contrast, integrates an LLM with an external retrieval system, typically querying a document index with a neural retriever and prompting the model to generate output based on retrieved content [ 13 , 1 ] .
We did not adopt RAG for survey pre-filling from long STI policy documents for two reasons: first, the knowledge to be extracted from scraped policy content was not explicitly defined, making it difficult to formulate direct fact-based queries; second, adapting RAG by splitting survey questions into smaller prompts leads to redundancy, as overlapping policy indicators and guidelines produce overlapping content.
blocks.zh:
长结文字内结文字学习是指LLMS具有扩展上下文窗口的能力,可以将嵌入长的提示中的例子概括化,通常跨越数千个符号[3]. 反之,检索-增强生成(RAG)将LLM与外部检索系统整合,一般使用神经检索器查询文档索引,并促使模型根据检索的内容生成输出[13,1].
我们没有从长期科学、技术和创新政策文件中采用RAG来进行预先填充调查,原因有两个:第一,没有明确界定从废弃政策内容中提取的知识,因此难以直接提出基于事实的询问;第二,通过将调查问题分成较小的提示来调整RAG,导致重复,因为政策指标和准则重叠,导致内容重叠。

blocks.en: Long-context in-context learning enables the inclusion of complete content, survey questions, and extraction guidelines in a single extended prompt. We adopted this approach to preserve coherence, incorporate examples, and capture relevant material without restricting nuanced findings. The context window accommodated most cases in our dataset.
blocks.zh: 文本中的长文本学习能够将完整内容、调查问题和提取准则纳入一个扩展的快速中。 我们采用这种方法是为了保持一致性、纳入实例和捕捉有关材料,同时又不限制细微的调查结果。 上下文窗口包含了我们数据集中的大多数案例。

blocks.en: Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 快速设计

blocks.en: We incorporated survey questions and OECD guidelines into the prompt design. The prompts covered descriptions, objectives, policy instruments, target groups, policy themes, start date, budget, and evaluation report. They instructed the model to respond in English, rely only on the provided content, and return structured outputs for easier parsing and integration. The full prompts are provided in Appendix 0.B.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们把调查问题和经合组织准则纳入迅速设计。 这些提示涉及说明、目标、政策工具、目标群体、政策主题、开始日期、预算和评价报告。 他们指示该模式以英语回应,只依靠提供的内容,并返回结构化产出,以方便解析和整合。 附录0.B.3提供了全部提示。

blocks.en: Response Validation
blocks.zh: 答复验证

blocks.en:
LLM-based evaluation has become common for assessing generated outputs on dimensions such as groundedness, completeness, and relevance [ 10 , 14 , 22 , 12 ] .
Research indicates that larger model sizes generally produce improved performance in summarization evaluation, with stronger correlation to human judgments [ 15 , 6 ] . In addition, evaluation methods may employ reference-based approaches that compare the generated text with the ground truth or reference texts [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh:
以LLM为基础的评价在评估基于、完整性和相关性等方面的产出[10、14、22、12]方面已成为常见。
研究显示,更大的模型尺寸一般能提高总结评价的性能,与人类判断更紧密的关联性[15,6]. 此外,评价方法可能采用基于参考的方法,将生成的案文与地面真相或参考案文进行比较[25]。

blocks.en: To validate the generated responses, we employed another instance of the LLM to evaluate them against the prompt and source material. A binary scoring scheme assessed evidence and relevance , indicating whether each response was supported by the text and followed the instructions. The structured validation prompt is provided in Appendix 0.B.1 . This step filtered out cases that could have resulted from hallucinations or misinterpretations.
blocks.zh: 为了验证所生成的回复,我们采用了另一个LLM实例来对照即时和来源材料评估这些回复。 一项二进制评分办法评估了证据和相关性,指出每项答复是否得到案文的支持并遵循指示。 结构化的验证速率见附录0.B.1。 这一步骤过滤了可能因幻觉或误解而导致的案件。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluations
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价

blocks.en: In addition to response validation, we incorporated three further evaluation measures. 1. Overlap analysis compared human- and LLM-generated survey responses, capturing the extent of alignment between the two datasets. 2. Label-wise agreement scoring quantified consistency between human annotations and model outputs for policy labels using high-, medium-, and low-agreement categories. 3. K-fold cross-validation validated LLM-generated labels using fine-tuned masked and causal models, addressing the absence of a full gold-standard reference for all structured policy indicators.
blocks.zh: 除了回应验证外,我们还纳入了三项评估措施。 1. 重叠分析比较了人类和LLM生成的调查答复,掌握了两个数据集之间一致的程度。 2. 标签协议对使用高、中、低协议类别的政策标签的人类说明与示范产出之间的量化一致性评分。 3. K倍交叉验证验证了LLM生成的标签,采用了微调的蒙面模型和因果模型,解决了所有结构化政策指标没有完全黄金标准参考的问题.

blocks.en: Overlap analysis compared human- and LLM-generated survey responses, capturing the extent of alignment between the two datasets.
blocks.zh: 重叠分析比较了人类和LLM产生的调查答复,掌握了两个数据集之间一致的程度。

blocks.en: Label-wise agreement scoring quantified consistency between human annotations and model outputs for policy labels using high-, medium-, and low-agreement categories.
blocks.zh: 标签式协议对使用高、中、低协议类别的政策标签的人类说明与示范产出之间的量化一致性评分。

blocks.en: K-fold cross-validation validated LLM-generated labels using fine-tuned masked and causal models, addressing the absence of a full gold-standard reference for all structured policy indicators.
blocks.zh: K倍跨验证验证验证了LLM生成的标签,使用微调的蒙面模型和因果模型,解决了所有结构化政策指标缺乏完整的金标准参考的问题.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
In our experiments, we performed survey pre-filling using LLMs as survey respondents to extract and generate multiple types of survey fields. Our study addressed two key questions: (1) Can web-scraped content provide sufficient and relevant information to pre-fill STIP Compass survey questions? (2) Is it feasible to map unstructured web-scraped content to structured survey categories using LLMs to generate survey responses in place of human respondents?
We hypothesized that long-context LLMs could capture a significant portion of structured information for free-text fields as well as multi-label policy identification.
blocks.zh:
在我们的实验中,我们利用LLMs作为调查对象进行了调查前填充,以提取和生成多种类型的调查领域. 我们的研究涉及两个关键问题: (1) 网络搜索内容能否为填充前的STIP Compass调查问题提供足够的相关信息? (2) 将无结构的网络搜索内容映射到结构化的调查类别中,利用LLMs生成调查答复以取代人类答复者,是否可行?
我们假设,长文本LLMS可以捕捉很大一部分结构化信息,用于自由文本字段和多标签政策识别。

blocks.en: 4.1 Choice of LLM
blocks.zh: 4.1 LLM的选择

blocks.en: We selected GPT-4o-128k [ 20 ] for our study because of its extended context window and strong performance across evaluation benchmarks. The selection was supported by the latest metrics from Stanford’s Holistic Evaluation of Language Models (HELM), which provides a comprehensive assessment of language models’ capabilities and limitations. According to the HELM leaderboard 1 1 1 https://crfm.stanford.edu/helm/lite/latest , GPT-4o (2024-05-13) achieved a mean win rate of 0.938 on standard evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了GPT-4o-128k[20]作为我们的研究对象,因为其上下文窗口较长,而且各评价基准的业绩良好。 这一选择得到了斯坦福语言模型综合评价(HELM)最新衡量标准的支持,该评价对语言模型的能力和局限性进行了全面评估。 根据HELM领导板1 1 1 https://crfm.stanford.edu/helm/lite/latest,GPT-4o(2024-05-13)在标准评价指标上实现了0.938的中胜率.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Design
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价设计

blocks.en: To validate the generated responses, we employed another instance of GPT-4o-128k to evaluate the responses against the prompt and raw material. We used a structured evaluation prompt ( 0.B.1 ) to ensure consistency in assessing the generated responses, focusing on their adherence to the source material and relevance to the instructions.
blocks.zh: 为了验证所生成的回复,我们采用了另一个GPT-4o-128k实例,对照即时和原材料来评估这些回复。 我们利用一个结构化的评估即时(0.B.1)来确保评估所产生答复的一致性,重点是它们遵守源材料和与指示的相关性。

blocks.en: For post-extraction evaluations, we again employed GPT-4o-128k as an evaluator for free-text fields, including descriptions and objectives. We designed a prompt ( 0.B.2 ) to compare overlaps and discrepancies between human participants and LLM-generated responses. The prompt instructs the LLM to quantify the results into four categories: full overlap, high overlap, low overlap, and no overlap. However, the degree of overlap against policy labels was quantified using overlap percentages. We computed agreement scores using micro F1 scores throughout the dataset. Similarly, micro F1 scores were used to evaluate k-fold (k=5) cross-validation experiments by fine-tuning (system prompt 0.B.4 ) a range of masked and causal models (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 对于抽取后的评价,我们再次使用GPT-4o-128k作为自由文本领域的评价者,包括描述和目标。 我们设计了一个即时(0.B.2 )来比较人类参与者与LLM生成的反应之间的重叠和差异. 即时指示LLM将结果量化为四类:完全重叠,高重叠,低重叠,无重叠. 然而,与政策标签的重叠程度是以重叠百分比量化的。 我们用整个数据集的 F1 微分计算协议得分 同样,微分F1分数也被用于通过微调(系统提示0.B.4)一系列蒙面模型和因果模型(表5)来评价k倍(k=5)交叉验证实验.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
Data preparation, pre-filling, response validation, and free-text evaluation were conducted using Azure AI Services 2 2 2 https://ai.azure.com with different GPT-4o deployments.
Dataset analysis and agreement scores were computed using standard Python libraries. In k-fold cross-validation, the dataset was shuffled and split into 80% training, 10% validation, and 10% testing for each fold.
The main hyperparameters for masked and causal models, as well as LoRA configurations, are summarized in Appendix 0.A .
blocks.zh:
数据准备、预先填充、反应验证和自由文本评价使用Azure AI Services 2 2 2 https://ai.azure.com 进行了不同的GBT-4o部署。
数据集分析和协议分数是使用标准Python库计算的. 在k倍的交叉验证中,数据集被洗涤并分为80%的训练,10%的验证,以及10%的测试每个折叠.
蒙面模型和因果模型的主要超参数以及LORA配置概要见附录0.A.

blocks.en: 4.4 Cost
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 费用

blocks.en: Running the experiments with GPT-4o incurred a total cost of € 446.84. This cost applies to the six-country pilot, not full OECD deployment. Full-scale costs would increase with document volume and length, but can be reduced through URL filtering, cached scraping, selective summarization, and targeted human review.
blocks.zh: 用GPT-4o进行实验的费用总额为446.84欧元。 这一费用适用于六个国家的试点,而不是经合组织的全面部署。 全面的成本将随着文件的量和长度而增加,但可以通过URL过滤、缓存刮取、选择性汇总和有针对性的人文审查来降低成本。

blocks.en: 5 Results & Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: The results compare human- and LLM-generated survey responses across six OECD countries, focusing on free-text fields and policy indicator labels. The following subsections present human-LLM overlap, label agreement, and k-fold cross-validation results.
blocks.zh: 调查结果比较了经合组织6个国家的人为和LLM生成的调查答复,重点是自由文本领域和政策指标标签。 以下各小节介绍人类-LLM重叠,标签协议,以及k倍交叉验证结果.

blocks.en: 5.1 Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集分析

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the country-level statistics after data preparation and filtering. The Insufficient column refers to the share of policy initiatives without URLs or containing less than 200 tokens. The Unidentified column presents initiatives that have sufficient content, but relevant policy instruments could not be extracted. The Sufficient column shows percentages of initiatives that have sufficient and suitable web content. The last column reports the number of samples with appropriate STI content from policy initiatives.
blocks.zh: 表2列出在数据编制和过滤之后的国家一级统计数据。 不足栏指没有URL或含有少于200个令牌的政策举措的份额. 该栏介绍了内容充分但相关政策工具无法提取的举措。 足够的栏目显示具有足够和适当网络内容的倡议的百分比。 最后一栏报告了政策举措中具有适当科技和创新含量的样本数量。

blocks.zh: 每个样本包含8项政策指标。 政策工具、目标群体和政策主题包括提及科技和创新政策基础的其他分标签。 表3比较了人类产生的和LLM产生的标签覆盖范围.

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of label statistics between expert-generated and LLM-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 表3:专家生成的标签和LLM生成的标签之间的标签统计比较.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of policy indicator labels between expert-generated and LLM-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 图2:专家生成的标签与LLM生成的标签之间的政策指标标签比较.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the frequency distribution of policy labels by class. Both datasets exhibited similar label distributions, with a significant imbalance across classes. Many labels are underrepresented, with low frequencies in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 图2按类别显示政策标签的频率分布情况。 两个数据集的标签分布相似,各类别之间严重失衡。 许多标签代表不足,数据集频率低.

blocks.en: 5.2 Human-LLM Overlap
blocks.zh: 5.2 人类LLM 重叠

blocks.en:
We investigated qualitative differences in free-text responses, identifying complementary tendencies in which LLMs delivered more detailed procedural accounts, while human respondents emphasized contextual and societal dimensions.
Figure 3 shows the overlap results for both free-text fields.
blocks.zh:
我们调查了自由文本答复中的质量差异,找出了补充性的趋势,即有限责任公司提供了更详细的程序说明,而人类答复者则强调了背景和社会层面。
图3显示两个自由文本字段的重叠结果。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overlap of survey participant responses and LLM responses per country on the policy initiative description and objectives.
blocks.zh: 图3:各国对政策倡议说明和目标的调查参与者答复和LLM答复重叠。

blocks.en: The analysis of overlap between descriptions indicated that the predominant share of cases (74.05%) exhibited high overlap, whereas only 1.19% demonstrated full overlap, 15.24% were classified as low overlap, and 9.52% showed no overlap. These differences suggest that human and AI assessments can complement each other by offering diverse perspectives and insights on the same topics. However, the objective fields showed high overlap in 41% of the cases, while no overlap was observed in about 36% of the cases. Low overlap and full overlap were less frequent, occurring in 22% and 1% of cases, respectively. These patterns suggest that differences often stem from variations in approach, level of detail, scope, and available information for assessments.
blocks.zh: 对描述之间重叠的分析表明,案件的主要部分(74.05%)呈现出高度重叠,而只有1.19%显示完全重叠,15.24%被列为低重叠,9.52%显示没有重叠。 这些差异表明,人类和大赦国际的评估可以通过就同一专题提出不同的观点和见解来相互补充。 然而,在41%的案件中,客观领域出现高度重叠,而在大约36%的案件中没有观察到重叠。 低重叠和完全重叠的频率较低,分别为22%和1%。 这些模式表明,不同之处往往来自方法、详细程度、范围和可供评估使用的信息的不同。

blocks.en: The divergence in free-text fields appears to reflect differences in emphasis rather than only disagreement. Human responses are generally more concise and contextual, while LLM responses often provide more procedural detail from the scraped text. This is especially visible for objectives, where the LLM may describe implementation steps, whereas human respondents express broader policy aims.
blocks.zh: 自由文本字段的分歧似乎反映了重点的不同,而不仅仅是分歧。 人类的反应一般更为简洁和贴切,而LLM的答复则常常从废稿中提供更多的程序性细节. 对于目标来说,这一点尤其明显,因为《最低责任法》可以描述执行步骤,而人类答复者则表达了更广泛的政策目标。

blocks.en: Table 4: Overlap of survey participant responses and LLM responses per country for policy instruments (A), target groups (B), and policy themes (C).
blocks.zh: 表4:各国对政策文书(A)、目标群体(B)和政策主题(C)的调查参与者答复和长期管理指标答复重叠。

blocks.en:
We further examined overlap in multi-label indicators—policy instruments, target groups, and policy themes—to evaluate LLM outputs relative to human experts.
Table 4 shows the overlap between labels provided by human participants and those generated by the LLM. The table includes all overlapping cases where at least one policy label overlapped. The LLM performed relatively well in capturing survey respondent codes for policy themes and instruments, and particularly well for policy target groups. On average, in 95% of policy initiatives the LLM identified at least one of the target groups provided by survey respondents. The corresponding averages are 84% for policy themes and 85% for policy instruments. Although some variation exists across countries, these differences are generally limited.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步审查了多标签指标——政策工具、目标群体和政策主题——的重叠情况,以评价与人类专家有关的LLM产出。
表4显示了人类参与者提供的标签与LLM产生的标签之间的重叠. 该表包括至少一个政策标签重叠的所有重叠情况。 地方语言材料在为政策主题和文书收集调查答卷人守则方面表现相对较好,特别是为政策目标群体收集这些守则。 平均而言,在95%的政策举措中,LLM至少确定了调查答卷人提供的目标群体之一。 相应的平均政策主题为84%,政策工具为85%。 虽然各国之间存在一些差异,但这些差异一般是有限的。

blocks.en: 5.3 Human-LLM Agreement
blocks.zh: 5.3 人类-LLM 协议

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents the distribution of the label-wise agreement scores. The agreement scores shown in the graph are quite dispersed, ranging from high to low, reflecting the overall average level of agreement between human respondents and the LLM. Given that policy indicators span a wide range of dimensions, achieving consistently high agreement is challenging and depends on interpretation, comprehension, and background knowledge.
blocks.zh: 图4列出了标签协议分数的分布情况。 图中显示的协议分数相当分散,从高到低不等,反映了人类受访者与LLM之间的总体平均协议水平. 鉴于政策指标涉及广泛层面,达成一贯高水平的共识具有挑战性,并取决于解释、理解和背景知识。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Human vs LLM agreement score distribution. High agreement scores are shown in green, medium scores in blue, and low scores in red.
blocks.zh: 图4:Human vs LLM协议得分分配. 高协议分数以绿色显示,中分以蓝色显示,低分以红色显示.

blocks.en:
Our analysis indicates that policy indicators with clear and unambiguous definitions tend to yield higher levels of agreement. The top three labels, one from each category, are clearly interpretable and are as follows: PI015: “Indirect financial support|Tax or social contributions relief for firms investing in R&D and innovation” , TG21: “Research and education organisations|Public research institutes” , TH92: “Net zero transitions|Net zero transitions in energy” .
Low agreement mainly arises from abstract or broad labels, overlap between categories, and general terminology in policy definitions. The three labels with the lowest scores, one from each category, are as follows: PI010: “Direct financial support|Procurement programmes for R&D and innovation” , TG25: “Firms by age|Firms of any age” , TH16: “Public research system|Public research debates” .
These patterns highlight that the clarity and specificity of policy indicator definitions play a decisive role in shaping the degree of agreement between human respondents and the LLM.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析表明,具有明确和毫不含糊定义的政策指标往往能产生更高程度的一致意见。 前三个标签,每个类别各一个,都有明确的解释,如下: PI015:“对在研发和创新方面投资的公司提供间接财政支助或社会捐助减免”,TG21:“研究和教育组织[......]公共研究机构”,TH92:“能源零过渡网络[......]零过渡网络”。
协议程度低主要产生于抽象或宽泛的标签、类别之间的重叠以及政策定义中的一般术语。 分数最低的三个标签,每个类别各一个,分别如下: PI010:“直接财政支助+研发和创新采购方案”,TG25:“按年龄分列的问题+任何年龄的难题”,TH16:“公共研究系统+公共研究辩论”。
这些模式突出表明,政策指标定义的清晰和具体,对确定人类答卷人与LLM之间的一致程度起着决定性作用。

blocks.en: 5.4 Cross-Validation
blocks.zh: 5.4 交叉更改

blocks.en: The cross-validation results are reported using micro F1 scores, as shown in Table 5 . The experiments were conducted with several open- and closed-source models.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,交叉验证结果使用微分F1进行报告。 这些实验是用几种开源和闭源模型进行的。

blocks.en: Table 5: K-fold cross-validation micro F1 scores for LLM-generated policy indicators.
blocks.zh: 表5:LLM生成的政策指标的K倍交叉验证微F1分数.

blocks.en: RoBERTa achieved moderate F-scores, primarily due to its limited input length, whereas its BigBird variants performed better due to their extended input length and block-sparse attention mechanism. In contrast, causal models demonstrated a stronger ability to capture information from longer documents and achieved higher F-scores in multi-label classification. These results highlight the importance of model architecture and context length in determining performance on complex policy classification tasks.
blocks.zh: RoBERTA实现了中度F分数,这主要是因为其输入长度有限,而其BigBird变体因其输入长度延长和块状散射注意机制而表现较好. 与此相反,因果模型显示更有能力从较长的文档中获取信息,并在多标签分类中实现了更高的F分数. 这些成果突出了模型架构和背景长度在确定复杂政策分类任务的业绩方面的重要性。

blocks.en: 5.5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The findings of this study demonstrate that LLMs can act as effective “artificial respondents” for the OECD STIP Compass, offering both efficiency and depth in survey data collection. The comparison between human-generated and LLM-generated responses highlights strong complementarities rather than simple substitution. Specifically, while LLMs tend to provide more detailed procedural and descriptive accounts, human experts emphasize the contextual and societal implications of policy initiatives.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的结果表明,有限责任公司可以作为经合组织科学、技术和革新政策指南的有效“人工答复者”,在调查数据收集方面提供效率和深度。 人类产生的反应和LLM产生的反应的比较突出了强有力的互补性而不是简单的替代。 具体来说,虽然法学硕士往往提供更详细的程序和描述性说明,但人类专家强调政策举措的背景和社会影响。

blocks.en:
The overlap analysis shows that LLMs achieve high overlap in structured indicators, with agreement levels of 84–95% across policy instruments, target groups, and themes. However, in free-text fields such as initiative descriptions and objectives, divergences remain. Only 1.19% of the cases reached full overlap, while the majority (74.05%) demonstrated high but not identical overlap.
The qualitative interpretation of these divergences suggests that they are mainly associated with differences in granularity, framing, and source dependence. LLM-generated responses tend to remain close to explicit source content and provide more procedural detail, whereas human respondents more often compress information and incorporate contextual interpretation. This reinforces the value of a hybrid workflow in which LLMs support initial drafting and pre-filling, while human experts validate objectives and adjust contextual framing.
blocks.zh:
重叠分析表明,有限责任方案在结构化指标方面实现高度重叠,政策工具、目标群体和主题的协议水平为84-95%。 然而,在倡议说明和目标等自由文本领域,仍然存在分歧。 只有1.19%的案件完全重叠,而大多数案件(74.05%)的重叠率很高,但并不完全相同。
对这些差异的定性解释表明,这些差异主要与颗粒性、框架和来源依赖性的差异有关。 由LLM生成的答复往往仍然接近明确的源内容,并提供更多的程序细节,而人类答复者更经常压缩信息并纳入背景解释. 这加强了混合工作流程的价值,在这种工作流程中,法学硕士支持初步起草和预填,而人类专家则验证目标和调整背景框架。

blocks.en: These patterns highlight the potential of hybrid approaches: LLMs can reduce reporting burdens by pre-filling surveys with structured and detailed information, while human experts can refine, contextualize, and interpret these responses. Nevertheless, risks remain. Over-reliance on synthetic LLM outputs may lead to biases, redundancy, or “model collapse” if such outputs are recursively integrated into training data. Ensuring continuous human oversight and triangulation with original sources is thus essential for the long-term integrity of international policy monitoring. In practical deployment, these risks can be mitigated through source-grounded prompting, evidence-based validation, periodic human audits, and avoidance of recursive reuse of unverified AI-generated outputs as training or reference data. These safeguards are especially important for free-text fields, where hallucination and framing bias are more likely than in constrained taxonomy selection.
blocks.zh: 这些模式突出了混合方法的潜力: 通过预先填充有条理和详细信息的调查,有限责任公司可以减轻报告负担,而人类专家则可以对这些答复进行精细化、背景化和解释。 然而,风险依然存在。 过度依赖合成LLM产出可能导致偏差、冗余或“模型崩溃”,如果这些产出被反复纳入培训数据。 因此,确保人类持续监督和利用原始来源进行三角定位对于国际政策监测的长期完整性至关重要。 在实际部署中,这些风险可以通过基于来源的提示、基于证据的验证、定期的人力审计以及避免反复重复使用未经核实的AI产生的产出作为培训或参考数据来缓解。 这些保障措施对于自由文字领域特别重要,在这些领域,幻觉和框定偏差比受限制的分类选择更可能。

blocks.en: Overall, the evidence supports the viability of integrating AI into the STIP Compass workflow. Doing so would not only improve scalability and reduce costs but also enhance the descriptive richness of policy monitoring—provided safeguards are in place to preserve contextual accuracy and mitigate systemic biases.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,证据支持将AI纳入STIP Compass工作流程的可行性. 这样做不仅可以提高可扩展性,降低成本,而且可以加强政策监测的描述性,提供保障以保持背景准确,减少系统性偏见。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
This study introduces an integrated LLM-based pipeline for policy monitoring within the OECD STIP Compass, demonstrating that AI can complement human expertise in large-scale international surveys. By leveraging long-context in-context learning and a secondary validation layer, the approach achieves high overlap with human-generated responses across structured indicators, while providing additional procedural detail in free-text fields. The results highlight three key findings: 1. Efficiency gains – LLMs can reduce manual reporting burdens by pre-filling structured survey categories. 2. Complementary perspectives – LLMs enrich the descriptive layer of policy
initiatives, while human respondents provide necessary contextualization and societal framing. 3. Scalability with safeguards – Hybrid human-AI systems can improve international
policy intelligence, but careful oversight is required to address risks of bias, redundancy, and
over-reliance on synthetic outputs.
